reviews.t: Not the same Tigi Bed Head I've been delivered in past
reviews.x: I've gotten the actual Tigi Bed Head Manipulator in stores and online before and this batch of 3 wasn't what I usually get. The consistency was very liquid, while it should be more like honey. I ordered it from another seller and the other batch was what I usually get. Also this order had a different label, which I believe said "Non USA" or something like that, will have to double check when I get home.

Last time to buy this off of Amazon. Hard and barely able to use. I know what this product should be like and the consistency is not right....again. Every now and then you can find a seller with good stuff, but the majority of the time you get product that is hardened up. There are hundreds of reviews to back me up. I will pay retail from now on and get good stuff.

This not only helps me with volume and texture, but it also keeps my hair shiny. I have fine and wavy hair, and I can control the style I want to coax it into without any problem. I used to use Texture Twist until they discontinued it (fools), and I worried that I'd lose the control I had with it. I tried a number of products until my hairdresser let me know that his husband uses this and was also addicted to Texture Twist. This stuff is certainly great for me. And it smells nice, particularly a

as someone with about an inch hair this stuff is perfect for me.  Never gets too hard, can always re shape during the day, get overall gel.  The place I went to get haircuts stopped selling this so I came here to get it.  The only issue is with the three pack they are taped together and sometimes it causes the container to have an area of "Sticky" but i can deal with it for the price.

Yep the real deal. Most amazing price. This is 17.00-25.00 in a brick and mortar. All 3 for 26.00!!! Sold. I have been using this for years so glad to see it on Amazon. I have a pixie and this is perfect for my hair. Gives volume and style but isn’t hard or crunchy.  A tiny bit goes a long way. These three jars will last me a year.

reviews.t: Best product for getting a great hold without stiffness
reviews.x: I have short straight hair. I like to wear my hair looking curly and this product is fantastic. My hair stays soft but holds curls after I apply to my wet hair and then scrunch it up. I don’t even have to use a curling iron! Other products left my hair so crunchy and were hard to get out of my hair. This product is fantastic.

reviews.t: Still not like it used to be
reviews.x: Advertized as coconut.  Nope, it's still the new candy smell and watered down.  :( The original coconut was thicker, smelt better, and worked better.
DO NOT BUY!! Its been watered down to where you can pour it out! THEIVES!! PRODUCT NOT ORIGINAL!! FAKE!!! NO STARS!!

reviews.t: Definition for straight or curly hair!
reviews.x: Tigi Bes Head Manipulator is a terrific hair product. Both my daughter and I use it to give definition to our hair styles. My hair is straight, and I use it to define the clipped ends of my hair. My daughters hair is very curly, and she uses it to define and hold her curls. It really makes a difference in your hair style. It makes your hair look as if it were professionally styled. I buy this product over and over, its that good!

love this stuff.  I have super thick short hair and a lot of products just weigh it down which makes it look sloppy.  I love how i don't have to use a lot of this gunk and it makes my hair stay in place.  great when i want that messy look or just a little definition.  plus it doesn't have a lot of shimmer which can make your hair look greasy.

reviews.t: ... NO HOLD I was hoping it would be as good as Matte Separation
reviews.x: Has absolutely NO HOLD I was hoping it would be as good as Matte Separation.  I now have a 3 pack I will never use.  Would not buy again.  With that said I LOVE Bedhead products.  I wear my hair crazy funky spiked going back.  I would love to be able to swap the 2 unopened containers of Manipulator for 2 Matte Separation.

reviews.t: Was literally like water. Actually spilled when I opened them or ...
reviews.x: I think they spread one can over three. Was literally like water. Actually spilled when I opened them or tipped the container. Used this product for 15 years. It's not suppose to be the consistency of water. Many other places to buy the real product.

reviews.t: This is not the AUTHENTIC Bed Head Manipulator!
reviews.x: This is not the authentic Tigi Bed Head Manipulator. It is a watered-down substance. It spills easily and creates a mess if the cap is not secured tightly. You are not getting a bargain if you are interested in purchasing the authentic manipulator.

reviews.t: I use this product all the time and love it. But from this seller all 3 jars ...
reviews.x: I use this product all the time and love it.  But from this seller all 3 jars are like water.  Total waste of money.  I have purchase this product before from Amazon and have never this problem before.  Very dissatisfied.
After reviewing the comments, I realized that I was shipped old product. there were also no safety seals on these. Starting to believe that I received either old product, or one that was refilled.
Great product at a very reasonable price. I've been using this product for many years and I love the hold without having hair that feels weighted down or greasy. Highly recommend this product.
What a crock! THIS IS NOT BEDHEAD. I've been using REAL BEDHEAD for nearly 20 years. I guess you get what you pay for. >:-/
Love this stuff, works for me.  And I got a twin pack so my teenage son could have his own.  He is a big fan too!

reviews.t: Runny - Not Thick like original version
reviews.x: I was hoping this item was exactly as it used to be - the original product was thick - not runny!
My favorite hair product ever. Works great, lasts long and it even smells really nice.
Ordered from Halmark Beauty and product was watery. I will not order from them again.
Exactly the same product as I've been buying for 3x the amount in the salon.
This is not a bed head product. Nothing like the actual product.
Everything was excellent. I use this in my hair.

claims.text: Many reviewers report receiving a watered-down, liquid product instead of the expected thicker consistency.
Several reviewers describe the product as hardened or difficult to use.
Some reviewers question authenticity, saying the product is fake or not the original.
Positive reviewers praise the product for providing hold and definition without stiffness or crunchiness.
Some reviewers note inconsistent quality across sellers, with only some providing good product.
